items.name_html: the offer IS the gate's answer
items.body_html: available_ops and the contract projection come from offerable_ops, which CALLS capability and reads the same declarations the validator enforces — agreement by identity, never by a mirrored condition

items.name_html: the summary is a headline, never authority
items.body_html: free text is required for humans and NEVER parsed, counted, or consulted by validation, policy, or verify; the load-bearing claims live in structured fields; a text↔fields consistency check is a negative guardrail only

an actor's success emit is a CLAIM; a verify-family gate reads an independent, machine-checkable artifact (exit code, diff, build result) — never the claim, never the summary; "a prior actor verdict exists" is separation, not verification

a verify gate's evidence is trusted only with a currency binding to the state it certifies — a green result from version N cannot satisfy a version-M transition; the inline process form is current by construction, STATED in its binding, not exempted

items.name_html: idempotency is pinned to the full contract
items.body_html: the payload_digest binds the basic-valid payload bytes + op kind + schema id + vocabulary versions — and NEVER the schema-normalized value (the idempotency rung runs first; the payload rung runs after selection); same op_id under a different digest is a visible op_id_collision, never a silent drop

items.name_html: a catalog version pins meaning forever
items.body_html: a payload referencing pairflow.findings.v1 is read under v1 rules for the life of the transcript; an incompatible vocabulary change is a NEW version, never a silent rewrite
